settings.activityHelp: Checks whether Homey has seen the device recently.
settings.timestampHelp: Use this when the device or app keeps track of when new data was last received.
settings.manualHelp: Let a Homey Flow confirm after a successful update that everything is still working.
settings.expected: Normally, I expect an update every
settings.timeout: Notify me after no valid update for
settings.timestampHint: Check the time field for each device. The value itself must show when new data was received.
settings.selectDevice: Select a device first. If it is missing, refresh the inventory.
settings.selectCapability: Select which timestamp indicates that new data has been received.
settings.timingOrder: Consider stale after must be equal to or longer than the expected update interval.
settings.observedMinimum: Activity and timestamp checks require a stale timeout of at least 2 minutes.
settings.invalidTiming: Enter a duration greater than zero, up to 525600 minutes (whole milliseconds).
settings.failed: The monitor could not be saved. Check the highlighted fields.
settings.retry: The monitor could not be saved. Try again; your changes are still here.
settings.missingField: Saved field is currently missing. The selection is preserved; check the source.
settings.duplicate: This device already has a monitor. Use Edit on its card.
settings.chooseMethod: Choose how freshness should be checked.
settings.maxFields: Select no more than 16 timestamp fields.
settings.chooseEncoding: Select the timestamp format used by the source.
settings.noteLimit: Keep the technical note within 2000 characters.
settings.optionalNoteLimit: Keep the optional note within 2000 characters.
settings.duplicateRefresh: This device already has a monitor. Refresh and edit the existing monitor.
settings.identityChanged: This device no longer belongs to the selected integration. Refresh and check the device.
settings.monitorMissing: This monitor no longer exists. Cancel and refresh before trying again.
settings.savedRefreshFailed: Monitor saved. Status could not be refreshed; use Refresh status to try again.
settings.refreshSuffix: Status could not be refreshed; use Refresh status to try again.
settings.emptyInventory: No devices are currently listed. Refresh the inventory to try again.
settings.timestampField: Which field contains the time data was received?
settings.noTimestampFields: This device has no suitable time field for ‘Last data received’. Choose Device activity or Flow confirmation.
settings.confirmBeforeSaving: Confirm or cancel the device selection before saving.
settings.maxMonitors: You can configure up to 500 monitors.
settings.missingDevice: __name__ is no longer in the inventory. Deselect it or refresh before saving.
settings.alreadyHasMonitor: __name__ already has a monitor. Deselect it and use Edit.
settings.loadFailed: Could not load settings: __error__. Use Refresh status to retry.
settings.deviceHelp: Choose the device whose freshness you want to monitor.
settings.capabilitiesHelp: The field value itself must contain a date and time, not a measurement or its last-change time. With several fields, a new time in any one counts as an update. Check that the source updates it when data is received.
settings.emptyCapabilities: This device has no suitable time field for ‘Last data received’. Choose Device activity or Flow confirmation.
settings.encodingHelp: Match the format used by the source. The local test source uses ISO.
settings.expectedHelp: How often should this source normally report activity or data?
settings.timeoutHelp: Alert when no valid update has been seen for this long. Activity and timestamp checks require at least 2 minutes.
settings.contractHelp: Optional note about why this signal provides reliable evidence of activity or delivery. Editing this note does not restart monitoring.
settings.emptyMonitors: No monitors yet. Choose Add monitor to get started.
settings.activityDetail: This proves activity, not necessarily a new measurement or successful delivery.
settings.dataDetail: The selected field must itself contain a date/time value updated by the source. A measurement value or its lastUpdated metadata is not a substitute. If several fields are selected, a new time in any one counts as an update.
settings.flowDetail: The confirmation must follow a real successful update. A blind repeating timer does not prove that the source works. Existing API confirmations remain supported.
settings.helpTimingExample: For updates every 5 minutes, you might expect an update every 5 minutes and alert after 15 minutes. Allow some margin for delays. The timeout must be at least the expected interval. Device activity and Last data received require at least 2 minutes.
settings.helpFirstTest: For a first test, monitor the test device with Last data received, Last test heartbeat, ISO format, a 0.5-minute expected interval and a 2-minute timeout.
settings.helpMethodTrouble: If Last data received never becomes HEALTHY, check the selected field, format and whether its time moves forward. If Device activity stays UNKNOWN, Homey may not provide a usable last-seen time.
settings.helpStart: Choose Add monitor above the list, then choose how to check for updates.
settings.helpSave: Choose Add monitors. Fields needing attention will be highlighted.
settings.unverifiedSavedField: Saved field: its current value was not recognized as a suitable time. Check the source; the selection is preserved.
settings.savedFormatMismatch: Saved field: its current value does not match the saved time format. Check the format; the selection is preserved.
settings.fieldFormatMismatch: The chosen time format does not match all selected fields. Choose fields with the same format.
